acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: PolyCore magenta retrofit bands and a white ceramic-isolation crown distinguish the annex while preserving its containment silhouette
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: three bench-scale isolation cells progress from ceramic to ceramic-metal hybrid trials before the route reaches the full-scale containment chamber and records store
acceptance_dimensions.functional_machinery_props: insulating-glass observation cells, mineral barrier coupons, steel backing plates, retrofit stock and the retained containment plant support comparative isolation testing
acceptance_dimensions.institutional_identity: PolyCore magenta/white zone coding and numbered ceramic test bays make the emergency substitution program legible without rebuilding the donor architecture
acceptance_dimensions.historical_damage_signature: successive cells show larger isolation fields and localized breaches while the full-scale ring carries a patched ceramic-metal shell, demonstrating delay rather than immunity
acceptance_dimensions.narrative_evidence_loot: guaranteed ceramic isolation result records that non-polymer barriers extended service life but still failed after environmental contamination
